content: {"episode_id":"ep-05074","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-97 denial for CPT 93271, cardiac event monitoring, on episode ep-05074. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for underlying arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I34.0, R00.2, and R42. As stated in the note, the cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances for further evaluation. We therefore request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of 358.20."}
